headword: {神出鬼没|しんしゅつきぼつ}

definitions.gloss: elusive; appearing and disappearing without warning
definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that shows up suddenly in unexpected places and vanishes just as quickly, so that no one can tell where it will be next.

examples.japanese: {神出鬼没|しんしゅつきぼつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{怪盗|かいとう}。
うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神出鬼没|しんしゅつきぼつ}だ。
examples.english: Our cat turns up anywhere and vanishes just as fast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神出鬼没|しんしゅつきぼつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧にいた⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}えば→思う：00492_omou⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れている→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: The department head is impossible to pin down: one moment he's in the meeting room, the next he has turned up at the factory.

notes:
A four-character idiom: {神|しん} (a god) {出|しゅつ} (appears), {鬼|き} (a demon) {没|ぼつ} (vanishes), that is, moving about as freely and mysteriously as gods and demons. Often half-humorous in everyday use.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {神出鬼没|しんしゅつきぼつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: an elusive ... (thief, ninja, guerrilla)
- {神出鬼没|しんしゅつきぼつ}だ: is impossible to keep track of
- {神出鬼没|しんしゅつきぼつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: to appear out of nowhere

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {変幻自在|へんげんじざい}: protean; changing form at will
